visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: One Generic Method Instead of Three Overloads
visualizerParams.problemDescription: larger is written three times, for int, String and double, with the same logic. Replace the overloads with one generic method. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: The three versions all say "compare and return the bigger one". With a bounded type parameter the comparison is written once and works for every type that can be compared.
